field_evidence.dataset_summary: Planning Data describes title boundaries, otherwise known as Land Registry Index polygons, as shapes showing the position and indicative extent of a registered property.
field_evidence.record_count: The official dataset page reports 22,740,586 title boundaries.
field_evidence.data_provider: The official dataset page identifies HM Land Registry as the data provider.
field_evidence.freshness: The collector last ran on 2026-09-07 and new data was last found on 2026-09-07.
field_evidence.origin_quality_note: The official dataset page states that the dataset contains some data created by MHCLG and that work is underway to replace it with data from authoritative sources.
field_evidence.licence: The official dataset page states Open Government Licence v3.0 and gives HM Land Registry / Ordnance Survey attribution for polygons and coordinates.
field_evidence.target_binding_limit: This dataset-level window does not identify which title-boundary entity, reference or polygon belongs to Forge Cottage and supplies no target-specific canonical parcel bbox.
field_evidence.parcel_promotion_rule: Dataset-level title-boundary availability is source-area evidence only. Target selection/spatial binding is reserved for local OpenCode, so no canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is promoted here.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. Planning Data's official Title boundary dataset page confirms an open public/no-login corpus of HM Land Registry title-boundary/index polygons showing the position and indicative extent of registered property, but this dataset-level window does not identify the Forge Cottage title-boundary entity/reference or target polygon/bbox. This is source-area evidence only and is not parcel progress. Local OpenCode must spatially or identifier-bind the exact target title-boundary record; after that, bind one exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to the resulting bbox.
exact_blocker: The method was materially changed from account-gated HM Land Registry MapSearch to the official public Planning Data Title boundary dataset inventory. The source confirms a large title-boundary/index-polygon corpus supplied by HM Land Registry and licensed for reuse, but the dataset-level window is not target-bound. Selecting the specific Forge Cottage polygon requires a spatial/identifier binding step reserved for local OpenCode. No canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is asserted and source-area evidence is not counted as parcel progress.
